series: trendwatching.com annual consumer trends (free Trend Briefing)
title: Half a dozen consumer trends for 2009
notes: December 2008 Trend Briefing. Labels from the numbered heading images' alt text (subtitle moved to note). target_year 2009 from the title. The paid 150+ page 2009 Trend Report is not captured.

entries.label: NICHETRIBUTES
entries.quote: NICHETRIBUTES are attributes / features / additions to existing products, making them more practical for specific user groups, while at the same time signaling to those users that the brand 'gets it’, that it cares, and in some cases even pays tribute to their lifestyle.
entries.subject: Product features for niche lifestyles
entries.note: Heading subtitle: 'Low-cost, practical tributes to the zeitgeist'.

entries.label: LUXYOURY
entries.quote: So in 2009, instead of worrying about missing out on the next big thing in luxury, focus on defining it.
entries.subject: Self-defined luxury
entries.note: Heading subtitle: 'In 2009, you decide what constitutes luxury'.

entries.label: FEEDBACK 3.0
entries.quote: FEEDBACK 3.0 is one of the trends-within-a-trend that is starting to make waves.
entries.subject: Brands responding to online consumer feedback in real time
entries.note: Heading subtitle: 'Think we've reached full transparency? You ain't seen nothing yet'. Sub-trend of TRANSPARENCY TYRANNY (2007).

entries.label: ECONCIERGE
entries.quote: ECONCIERGES are firms and services dedicated to helping households go green in any possible way.
entries.subject: Services helping households go green and save money
entries.note: Heading subtitle: 'Forget spending, eco will be about saving or even making'.

entries.label: MAPMANIA
entries.quote: any consumer-focused brand would be stupid not to be partnering or experimenting with map-based services.
entries.subject: Map- and location-based services
entries.note: Heading subtitle: 'Why the maps are the new interface'. Text cites Nokia expecting half of its handsets to be GPS enabled by 2010-2012 (Nokia's expectation, not trendwatching's).

entries.label: HAPPY ENDING
entries.quote: 2009 will be an excellent year for those businesses keen on showing consumers that they really care.
entries.subject: Brands showing care during the downturn
entries.note: Heading subtitle: 'The silver linings of each downturn'. Umbrella theme for the other five.
